kurals.tr: Porulal Lavaraip Porulaakach Cheyyum / Porulalladhu Illai Porul
kurals.m: Besides wealth there is nothing that can change people of no importance into those of (some) importance

kurals.tr: Illaarai Ellaarum Elluvar Selvarai / Ellaarum Seyvar Sirappu
kurals.m: All despise the poor; (but) all praise the rich

kurals.tr: Porulennum Poiyaa Vilakkam Irularukkum / Enniya Theyaththuch Chendru
kurals.m: The imperishable light of wealth goes into regions desired (by its owner) and destroys the darkness (of enmity therein)

kurals.tr: Araneenum Inpamum Eenum Thiranarindhu / Theedhindri Vandha Porul
kurals.m: The wealth acquired with a knowledge of the proper means and without foul practices will yield virtue and happiness

kurals.tr: Arulotum Anpotum Vaaraap Porulaakkam / Pullaar Purala Vital
kurals.m: (Kings) should rather avoid than seek the accumulation of wealth which does not flow in with mercy and love

kurals.tr: Uruporulum Ulku Porulumdhan Onnaarth / Theruporulum Vendhan Porul
kurals.m: The spoils of slaughtered foes; these are the royal revenues

kurals.tr: Arulennum Anpeen Kuzhavi Porulennum / Selvach Cheviliyaal Untu
kurals.m: The child mercy which is borne by love grows under the care of the rich nurse of wealth

kurals.tr: Kundreri Yaanaip Por Kantatraal / Thankaiththondru Untaakach Cheyvaan Vinai
kurals.m: An undertaking of one who has wealth in one's hands is like viewing an elephant-fight from a hill-top

kurals.tr: Seyka Porulaich Cherunar Serukkarukkum / Eqkadhanir Kooriya Thil
kurals.m: Accumulate wealth; it will destroy the arrogance of (your) foes; there is no weapon sharper than it

kurals.tr: Onporul Kaazhppa Iyatriyaarkku Enporul / Enai Irantum Orungu
kurals.m: To those who have honestly acquired an abundance of riches, the other two, (virtue and pleasure) are things easy (of acquisition)
